statements.t: We also intend to prioritize debt reduction while maintaining the financial flexibility necessary to support our operations and strategic initiatives.
We plan to continue to re-invest in our business in order to improve operational efficiencies and enhance the tools and services provided to our agents, franchisees and consumers.
Future capital allocation decisions with respect to return of capital in the form of share buybacks, will be at the discretion of our Board of Directors.

The Board of Directors will take into account general economic, housing and mortgage market conditions, the Company’s financial condition, available cash, current and anticipated cash needs, any applicable restrictions pursuant to the terms of our Term Loan Facility and any other factors that the Board of Directors considers relevant.
“Our 2027 outlook reflects the earnings potential of the combined company, even against a challenging housing market backdrop.

The Company's outlook assumes continued weakness in the residential real estate market, with management assuming a 5%–10% decline in U.S. existing-home sales and a 3%–4% decline in home prices in 2027.
